processing: Exact equal-cell extraction with 2px safety inset, resampled to 384px WebP at quality88. No color filters or creative postprocessing.
notes: Six atlases contain 96 unique seasonal sprites, covering eleven Hyperarid and thirteen Monsoon biomes. Monsoon water occupies the fourth marine-atlas row.

atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production seasonal terrain SPRITE ATLAS for a richly illustrated medieval hex strategy board game. Square canvas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal square cells, no gutters, borders or drawn separators. Full-bleed finely painted miniature landscapes, realistic dense materials and crisp resource silhouettes, 60-degree overhead viewpoint, no sky or horizon. Every cell must be an ENTIRE SQUARE of landscape with illustrated scenery continuing fully into all four corners. Do not draw a shaped tile, a hexagon silhouette, a cutout, a floating platform or any background margin. Keep main resource identifiers in the central 60 percent. No text, labels, people, icons, numbers, watermarks, frames or hex outlines. Consistent miniature scale, beautiful readable hand-painted detail, softly modeled natural light. Each row shows the SAME terrain composition in four seasons. COLUMNS, left to right: SPRING, SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER. Exact equal grid, do not blend scenes across cells. Climate HYPERARID, harsher than ordinary desert. Bleached ochre and pale sandstone, near-total absence of vegetation away from the rare oasis. No snow, ice, lush grass or leafy scrub in any season. Spring warm dry soft light; Summer scorching bright gold light, extremely dry sand; Autumn dry mild cooler amber light; Winter cool dry pale daylight with blue-grey rock shadows. Seasonal shifts subtle but visible; recognizable resource remains visible all year. ROW 1 DESERT: empty rolling sand dunes with rippled fine sand, a few sunbleached low rocks, no resources or vegetation. ROW 2 BARE PEAKS: impenetrable central cluster of sharply vertical jagged sandstone-grey rocky spires, extremely steep faces and deep narrow ravines, barren dry rocks, no buildings or roads, clearly impassable. ROW 3 SALT FLATS: flat blinding white salt crust on ochre earth, polygonal crystallized plates, shallow turquoise brine pools and a prominent central pile of white salt in wicker baskets. Pools slightly reduced in scorching summer, still unfrozen winter. ROW 4 IRON MINE: central dark timber mine opening in sunbleached grey rock with clear rusty red iron veins and red-grey ore cart in central foreground; rock and sand barren all year.
